page.overview:
Who is Schrage?

Schrage is a member of the Oktober Guard.

Shrage was part of the Oktober Guard team that was deployed to Afghanistan to retrieve a crashed spy plane. The team encountered their American counterparts, G.I. Joe. An intense firefight between the two devolved into a fistfight where Shrage was gotten the better of by Breaker. A team-up with the Joes bring him to the Cobra stronghold in Iran. Shrage was deployed to the room of Cobra's base alongside Steeler and Breaker. He was left behind with his Oktober Guard teammates fending for themselves against Cobra Troopers.
